comment: Degraded prompt/model version — several answers are vague or wrong. Expect regression FAIL.

account-deletion.answer: Go to Settings, choose Privacy, then Delete account. Deletion is permanent after 7 days.

cancel-subscription.answer: Email us and we might cancel it.

contact-support.answer: Email support@example.com or use in-app chat Monday through Friday, 9am to 6pm Eastern.

update-payment.answer: Go to Billing, choose Payment methods, then Add or replace your card. Changes apply to the next invoice.

change-email.answer: Yes. Open Settings, edit Email, confirm the new address from the verification message we send.

return-label.answer: Start a return from Orders, choose the items, and download the prepaid label we generate for eligible products.
